trap.label: convites (aceitar/recusar)
trap.wrong: I can’t go. I’m sorry, I have a compromise.
trap.right: I’m afraid I can’t go. I have another commitment.
trap.why: Compromisso é falso cognato de compromise (acordo). Para um compromisso marcado use appointment, plan, commitment.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com for + -ing: “Thanks. You invited me.”
Recuse com I’m afraid: “I can’t come.”
Reescreva com would: “I like to come.” (muito, aceitando convite)
